badges_policy.MEASURED: Run locally with method, environment, date, and raw output recorded.
badges_policy.SIMULATED: Synthetic workload or model estimation. A measured run on generated data carries both MEASURED and SIMULATED-WORKLOAD.
badges_policy.COURSE-EXAMPLE: Illustrative course video figure. Never a result.
badges_policy.GAP: Unmeasured baseline or target awaiting benchmark execution.
